question: Should OpenClaw accept standalone unused core termination/GSAR primitives now, or wait until the production `sessions_send` integration and trusted-evidence GSAR contract are designed?
rationale: The branch is now technically plausible and well covered, but repository policy keeps core lean and the PR deliberately defers the actual runtime integration point and evidence contract.

options.title: Approve core groundwork
options.body: Merge these primitives as intentional core foundation work and keep the linked feature tracker for production `sessions_send` integration and trusted-evidence follow-up.

options.title: Move the surface first
options.body: Ask the contributor to relocate the primitives to plugin SDK, agent-core, or another owner-approved package boundary before merge.

options.title: Park behind the tracker
options.body: Keep the open feature tracker as canonical and pause or close this branch until the production integration shape is ready.
